p: summer fruits: The Prophet takes upon himself the voice of the earth, which complains that all her fruits are gone, so that none are left: that is, that there is no godly man remaining, for all are given to cruelty and deceit, so that none spares his own brother.
they all lie in wait for: He shows that the prince, the judge, and the rich man are all linked together to do evil, and to disguise the deeds of one another.
great man: That is, the rich man that is able to give money, abstains from no wickedness or injury.
they wrap it up: These men agree among themselves, and conspire with one another to do evil.
a brier: They that are of most estimation and are counted most honest among them, are but thorns and briers to prick.
thy watchmen and thy visitation cometh: Meaning the prophets and governors.
I will look unto the LORD: The Prophet shows that the only remedy for the godly in desperate evils, is to flee to God for help.
O mine enemy: This is spoken in the voice of the Church, which calls the malignant church her enemy.
the day that thy walls are: That is, when God will show himself to be a deliverer of his Church, and a destroyer of his enemies.
the decree be far removed: Meaning the cruel empire of the Babylonians.

Assyria: When the Church will be restored, those that were enemies before will come out of all the corners of the world to her, so that neither fortresses, rivers, seas, nor mountains will be able to stop them.

their doings: Before this grace appears, he shows how grievously the hypocrites themselves will be punished, seeing that the earth itself, which cannot sin, will be made waste because of their wickedness.

Feed thy people with thy rod: The Prophet prays to God to be merciful to his Church, when they would be scattered abroad as in solitary places in Babylon, and to be beneficial to them as in times past.
According to the days of thy: God promises to be favourable to his people, as he had been before.
lay their hand upon their mouth: They will be as dumb men, and dare brag no more.
their ears shall be deaf: They will be astonished and afraid to hear men speak, lest they should hear of their destruction.
lick the dust like a serpent: They will fall flat on the ground because of fear.
passeth by the transgression of the: As though he did not see it, ignoring it.
their sins into the depths of: Meaning his elect.
truth to Jacob: The Church is assured that God will perform the truth of his merciful promise, which he had made long ago to Abraham, and to all that would apprehend the promise by faith.
